section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used in the current study: BMI (calculated from participants' self-reported weight and height), the Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale (SSPS), the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), the Inflexible Eating Questionnaire (IEQ), and the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). It reports internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha) values for these scales in the present study but provides no sample descriptors (e.g., sample size, age, country, ethnicity), no survey method, and no correlation between BAS-2 and BMI in the supplied text.
